personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT with 4 Tactile layout structure
personality_one_liner: A sophisticated, premium festival command center that feels like an elegant cultural editorial, grounded by friendly oversized tactile cards for effortless management.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for headers. Cards should have substantial inner padding (lg/xl) to feel tactile and oversized.

do's: Apply glassmorphism to bottom tab bar and sticky headers over scrollable feeds.
Use subtle glass over hero images in the Home dashboard.
Apply glassmorphism for Floating Action Buttons (FAB).
dont's: Do not apply glass to standard list items, task cards, or form inputs.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Role-based command center featuring a festival countdown and quick-access top metrics.

states.loading: Centered brand-colored activity indicator with 'Loading Command Center...'
states.empty: Illustration of Diya/Ganesha with 'Your dashboard is ready to be set up.'
states.error: Soft error message with Retry button

screens.layout: Hero section with Ganesha backdrop (gradient scrimmed) showing the countdown. Oversized stat cards (Donations, Volunteers) in a 2-column grid. Horizontal scrolling rail for quick role-based actions.

screens.name: Tasks (My Work)
screens.purpose: Tactile Kanban-style board or large list for friendly committee task management.

states.empty: Icon of a marigold flower with 'All tasks completed. Great seva!'

screens.layout: Pill-shaped chip filters at the top (To Do, Doing, Done). Oversized cards for tasks with generous padding, assignee initials, and a prominent 'Complete' button.

screens.name: Community (Calendar & Directory)
screens.purpose: Central hub for events, cultural programs, and committee member directory.

states.empty: Illustration of festival crowd with 'No upcoming events.'

screens.layout: Segmented control to toggle between Events and Members. Edge-to-edge cards for events featuring rich imagery. 1-column list with large avatars for the directory.

screens.name: More (Modules)
screens.purpose: Grid menu for deeper modules (Donations, Expenses, Seva AI, Voting, Gallery).
screens.layout: 3-column grid of large square tactile tiles with centered Phosphor icons and Devanagari-styled serif labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly avoid any blue, purple, or indigo colors. Use the provided Saffron, Gold, and Temple Maroon palette.
Implement Devanagari-inspired premium serif font (Cormorant Garamond) for headers/titles ONLY. Use Plus Jakarta Sans for all body text and UI labels.
Do NOT make the app look like an enterprise ERP. Focus on oversized, tactile, friendly components with generous safe padding.
For the My Work/Tasks screen, use swipeable large cards with haptic feedback to emphasize accomplishment and physical interaction.
Apply a top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim whenever rendering text over images (like the Home Hero Ganesha image) to ensure WCAG AAA readability.
Ensure touch targets are universally 44x44pt or larger, as this app is intended for non-technical community members.
Utilize Bottom Sheets for forms (like logging a donation or marking a task complete) instead of full-page navigation to minimize context switching.
Include subtle haptics on task completions, filter chip toggles, and primary CTA buttons.
